title: Red Hat Security Advisory: aspell security update
description: A security vulnerability in GNU Aspell allows arbitrary code execution via a crafted dictionary file. This flaw affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 and related products. Red Hat has issued an important security update to address this issue. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-103658 and is rated with high severity by the source. The update fixes the flaw by patching the aspell package. Users of affected Red Hat products should apply the update to mitigate the risk.
